author: Jordan
text: Absolutely great service fit me in to a full day so I didn’t have to pay an after hours call showed up 20 minutes before they were scheduled gave me a call ahead to let me know they were coming showed me before and after photos and they were pumped cleaned up and gone in 35 minutes! author: Chuck Caruso
text: Dooper Dold owns this business.  Don't waste your time or money doing business with him, there are plenty of other companies to choose from that will stand behind their word and you'll get what you pay for.  You know...reliable and trustworthy, the basic things you look for when paying someone for work.  Don't make the same mistake I made, keep looking, take your money elsewhere.
